nina: Change window tonight 23:00 UTC. Cross-service co-roll: runtime, api, console schema, router header-split. Reply ack if onwatch.

josh: ack. Ill run runtime canary and watch p99.

ria: ack. Ill take console schema migration and release note blurb.

nina: Plan: pin runtime v2.4.1, api v1.8.1, console schema 3.2.0, router header-split gated. Canary sizes: runtime 5%, api 3%, router 1% then 10%.

josh: Rollback criteria: p99 +120ms for 10m AND 5xx >0.5% OR 5xx >1% for 5m OR console parse errors >1%. Rollback order runtime -> api -> router.

ria: Ill run opt-eval at +15m; if median drops >3 points we abort.

nina: Deploybot commands verified: `/deploy runtime --tag v2.4.1 --canary 5`, `/deploy api --tag v1.8.1 --canary 3`, `/deploy router --feature header-split --percent 1`.

deploy-bot: Commands scheduled for 2026-03-23T23:00:00Z. Will post status.

josh: Quiesce background jobs at 22:50 UTC and increase logs retention to 7d.

josh: smoke check OK. p99 +5ms, 5xx 0.01%.

ria: eval result: delta -0.4 (ok). Publishing release notes now.
